Still desire more or wish to unleash your creativity? Our editor is available to anyone, allowing you to create your very own levels and share them on our cloud! Here you can also discover, play and rate levels 
made by other creators from all around the world!

So join Clicky on his wondrous adventure in Hidden Through Time!
